measures.what: Please measure board diameter and thickness; diameter and centre-to-centre spacing of the two M3 mounting holes; and each hole's (x,y) position relative to board centre, with +y toward the input wires. Also measure the tallest rear connector/solder protrusion and describe where it is. A ruler sketch is fine.
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: Measure perfboard width (x), length (y), thickness, four mounting-hole diameters and hole-centre positions (or rectangular centre spacings). With ESP32 installed, measure height above perfboard of tallest component, maximum solder projection below it, and USB-C port mouth centre (x,y,z) relative to perfboard top-face centre (+y along long side, +z toward ESP32). Which edge does USB face out of? Measure the actual plug's width, thickness and rigid length too, if possible.
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.item: assembled electronics, USB plug and wall screws
measures.what: Could you confirm: (1) Does USB face out across a 50 mm end of the perfboard, centred across its width? Please give port centre height above perfboard and clarify whether its mouth is 7.53+4.80 mm inward from the perfboard end, or another distance. (2) Largest height of terminals/capacitor above perfboard, and solder/wires below it? (3) Disk rear connector height/location (rough measurement is fine). (4) Wall screw head diameter, shaft diameter and intended spacing, or are these not chosen yet? (5) Do you have a white PLA spool for this box? Your printer setup lists black only.
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: For a simple open-bottom USB access bay, can you arrange the perfboard with its 50 mm end pointing down, USB port facing down and ESP32 facing forward toward the LED disk? Will all components fit in 25 mm above the perfboard, and all solder below it within 5 mm? Will the disk's rear wires/connector fit in a 15 mm clear gap? Also, can you check the disk is about 160 mm diameter using a paper/ruler template, even if calipers won't reach? Please answer these yes/no checks; they avoid needing more precise measurements.
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that; perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: One last layout check: looking at the component side of the perfboard, with USB pointing down, what are the USB mouth centre's left/right and up/down distances from the perfboard centre? Is its mouth 12.33 mm inward from the bottom edge (7.53 + 4.80)? If you can't measure this, say so; I can make a broad removable access panel rather than a close-fitting port hole. Also please say whether you can print the box in white PLA or only the listed black.
measures.reply: perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

limitations.wanted: Specify the requested matte-white printed box and verify all electronics clearances before finalizing.
limitations.blocked_by: Only black PLA is confirmed available; disk diameter/thickness, perfboard thickness, component/connector envelopes and exact USB position remain unmeasured. The printed fit coupon received no assessable result.
limitations.why: Colour cannot be guaranteed, and the final assembly needs a dry-fit check rather than a claim of verified fit.
